text.text: uBR10012 Universal Broadband Router

Get the performance, scalability, flexibility, and resiliency you need in a CMTS with the Cisco uBR10012. Powered by Cisco IOS Software, the Cisco uBR10012 is the most feature-rich CMTS on the market and offers best-in-class quality of service (QoS) features for transparent delivery of voice, video, and data services.

graphic.text: Get the performance, scalability, flexibility, and resiliency you need in a CMTS with the Cisco uBR10012. Powered by Cisco IOS Software, the Cisco uBR10012 is the most feature-rich CMTS on the market and offers best-in-class quality of service (QoS) features for transparent delivery of voice, video, and data services.

text.text: Front View
正面図
Vista frontal

With a standards-based, modular design and upgrade flexibility, the Cisco uBR10012 provides cable operators with a quick return on investment and an easy migration path for future growth. The product features advanced networking and routing options. PacketCable Multimedia (PCMM) and channel bonding are supported. Operators can optimize network utilization in real time for prioritized and aggregated resource demands from all PCMM applications and enhance the broadband subscriber experience by prioritizing or reserving bandwidth for latency-sensitive and feature-rich services. Operators can establish policies for how resources are allocated among multiple services and can set thresholds for dealing with demand spikes. With the Cisco uBR10012, cable operators can deploy unique, next-generation multimedia services with ease.

graphic.text:
With a standards-based, modular design and upgrade flexibility, the Cisco uBR10012 provides cable operators with a quick return on investment and an easy migration path for future growth.

The product features advanced networking and routing options. PacketCable Multimedia (PCMM) and channel bonding are supported.

Operators can optimize network utilization in real time for prioritized and aggregated resource demands from all PCMM applications and enhance the broadband subscriber experience by prioritizing or reserving bandwidth for latency-sensitive and feature-rich services.

Operators can establish policies for how resources are allocated among multiple services and can set thresholds for dealing with demand spikes.

With the Cisco uBR10012, cable operators can deploy unique, next-generation multimedia services with ease.

text.text: 標準ベースでモジュラタイプのデザインと アップグレードの柔軟性を兼備 したCisco uBR10012は、迅速な投資対効果とビジネス成長 へのスムーズな対応をケーブル事業者に確約します。 高度なネット ワーキングとルーティングのオプ ションを特長とする本製品は、PacketCable Multimedia (PCMM)とWideband (Channel bonding)をサポートします。 また、PCMM アプリケーションからの優先度と集約 リソース要求に対して リアルタイムでネットワークを 最適化し、遅延に敏感な サービス帯域幅への優先順位 付けによって、ブロード バンド加入ユーザの エクスペリエンスを向上できます。 さらに、複数サービス間における リソースの割り当てポリシー を確立し、要求の変化 に対応するしきい値を設定できます。 Cisco uBR10012により、 ユニークかつ簡単な次世代 マルチメディアサービスの展開が 実現されます。

text.text: Con un diseño modular basado en normas y flexibilidad de actualización, Cisco uBR10012 proporciona a los operadores de cable un rápido rendimiento de la inversión y una ruta de migración sencilla para el crecimiento futuro. El producto ofrece opciones avanzadas de redes y routing. Admite PacketCable Multimedia (PCMM) y Wideband (entrelazado de canales). Los operadores pueden optimizar el uso de la red en tiempo real para cubrir demandas priorizadas y agregadas de recursos de todas las aplicaciones PCMM y mejorar la experiencia del suscriptor de banda ancha al priorizar o reservar ancho de banda para los servicios sensibles a la latencia, con muchas funciones. Los operadores pueden fijar políticas que determinen la asignación de recursos entre múltiples servicios y establecer umbrales para administrar los picos de demanda. Con Cisco uBR10012, los operadores de cable pueden implementar fácilmente servicios multimedia únicos, de próxima generación.
